title: Rebatement
summary: REBA'TEMENT, noun 1. Diminution. 2. In commerce, abatement in price; deduction. 3. In heraldry, a diminution or abatement of the bearings in a coat of arms.

inlines.v: REBA'TEMENT, noun 1. Diminution. 2. In commerce, abatement in price; deduction. 3. In heraldry, a diminution or abatement of the bearings in a coat of arms.
